name: Migraine neurology
summary: How expats find migraine neurology care in Singapore — GP triage vs specialist, acute vs preventive meds, workplace trigger planning, and insurance panel realities.
body:
Migraine care usually starts with a GP diary and red-flag screen, then neurology when attacks are frequent, disabling, or atypical. Specialists discuss acute rescue plans, preventives, and lifestyle triggers in humid, high-stimulus workplaces.

## Decision points
- GP management vs neurology referral thresholds
- Acute rescue vs preventive medication pathways
- Imaging only when red flags justify it
- Work-from-office lighting / smell trigger plans
- Panel hospital vs private neurologist access

Keep a 4-week attack diary before the first specialist visit.

## How to choose
Prefer clinicians who separate migraine from tension headache clearly and set review dates for preventives. Ask about after-hours rescue advice. Confirm insurance pre-auth needs for injectables if discussed.

## Practical tip
Photograph your medication blister packs and attack calendar into one album. First visits waste time reconstructing doses from memory.
